lines.en: Full plate on my shoulders, one heavy step at a time.
My soles feel leaden, I move slow.
Don't rush me, this iron needs steady feet.
Every step presses into the mud.
Dragging the tower shield along this wall.
Slow I walk, but I hold ground.
Even the wind can't push me.
My plates clatter — no hiding that.
From the tower base down to the stair.
Ahead there — wait one step for me.
The pauldron numbs my neck.
The longer I stand, the heavier the armor.

lines.zh: 面罩里全是自己的呼吸声。
lines.en: Only my own breath inside the visor.
Counting wall bricks to pass the time.

lines.zh: 重甲最大的敌人是闷热。
lines.en: Heat is heavy armor's worst foe.
This tower shield is wider than me.
Someone loosen a strap for me?
A blade of grass is stuck in my plates.
I'm not idle — I'm listening.
Past noon the shadow shortens.
My knee guard's locked, can't bend.

lines.zh: 有人送了水，可惜没手接。
lines.en: Water came, but I've no hand free.
I'm a breathing boulder.
Halt, let me see your face.
I don't chase. I wait to be hit.

lines.zh: 你这把刀砍得动这层甲吗？
lines.en: Will that blade cut this plate?
Heavy guard here — the road ends.
To pass, beat this shield.
Good eyes — use them wisely.
You look like a light scout.
Don't circle me, my turns are slow.
Blue heavy guard — state your business.
That wound on your hand's not healed.

lines.zh: 再靠近，塔盾就要压下来。
lines.en: Closer and the tower shield drops.
Ten paces of iron between us.
A plate split. I still hold.
That got into the plate seam.
Visor's askew, I can't see well.
Padding's gone red. Keep quiet about it.
It hurts, but I can't shed the armor.
Bone thuds dully inside the steel.
I can still lift the shield.
A few more of those and I'll drop.
Stand firm, don't let them see.
Eating means lifting the visor — a chore.
Hot soup? Set it on the stone.
I smell roasting meat.
One bite's enough, I'm still on watch.
Mead warms the hands — cold in here.
Who's baking bread? That's unfair.
Just leave the jar by my feet.
Hunger hits fastest inside plate.
All I want is water, truly.

lines.zh: 这个香味让面罩更难摘。
lines.en: That smell makes the visor harder to lift.
Bump me? You just hit a wall.
Step back, I don't shift.
My shield caught you — my pardon.

lines.zh: 你这一下连甲都没蹭花。
lines.en: That didn't even scuff the plate.

lines.zh: 别从侧面挤，我转不过来。
lines.en: Don't squeeze past my flank, I can't turn.

lines.zh: 站稳，我的重量会压过来。
lines.en: Stand clear, my weight carries.
Made me sway half a step. Not bad.
You slipped — steady yourself.
Clear the way, I can't stop quickly.
Getting hit by this iron is no game.
Heavy knights don't talk of such things.

lines.zh: 我连自己的扣带都解不开。
lines.en: I can't even unbuckle myself.
After I'm out of armor — too much work.
My oath still rests on this sword.
The squad would laugh for a year.
Ask the captain's orders first.

lines.zh: 这身行头生来不是为家。
lines.en: This kit wasn't built for a household.
The steel's cold. Don't get ideas.
I guard walls, not hearts.
Stand still, don't touch my buckles.
Can't bend — I'll hook it with the spear.
This hammer head fits my grip.
A stone to wedge my plates.
That iron scrap is mine.
My gauntlet's worn through — perfect.
Oilcloth — good for the mail.
Small coins, into the wrist guard.
Someone's arrow — I stepped on it.

lines.zh: 捡起来给我，我抬不动腿。
lines.en: Pick it up for me, I can't lift a leg.
A strap, enough for the shoulder.
Locked on — this one's quick.
He's circling left, I see him.
Come on then, the plate's thick.
Shield up, hold this stretch of road.
He's heading for the tower — stop him.
No slipping through my gap.
I'm slow, but I don't miss.
Iron in hand settles the mind.
He's got an axe — trust the shield.
Target confirmed, moving in.
This shield faces him squarely.
He's backed to the wall — good.
I only walk straight lines. Enough.
He's tapping my plate. Pointless.
I push, he can only retreat.
Counting his swings — three.
He's winded. I'm not.
Wait until his edge dulls.
One step for me, two for him.
He's gone around my shield.
My gorget has a gap — I guard it.
Put weight in the step, press him.
His hands shake. I can see.
He thinks my turns are slow.
I'll let him hit this iron first.
The wall's behind me, nowhere back.
A moment more and he's spent.
I watch the point of his blade.
He swapped hands — mind the left.
I'm counting every beat of it.
The whole tower shield comes down!
A shoulder ram beats a blade.
Short sword, but heavy enough.
Strike the knee, make him kneel.
This blow was paid for in iron.
Don't dodge — the shield's quicker.
Guard's open — press on.
Again, put weight in it.

lines.zh: 我的甲替我挡了这一刀。
lines.en: My plate took that cut for me.
He's yielding. Advance.
A slant cut, shoulder to hip.
A shield's rim cuts, too.
Brace, or I'll drag you down.
I keep some strength in reserve.
He's guarding high — go low.
I'm slow, one hit is enough.
Blade falls, iron rings, step back.
Not done — one more.
Heavy armor in line steadies the wall.

lines.zh: 我一步踏上台阶，砖在响。
lines.en: One step onto the stair, the brick groans.
My turn to anchor this wall.
Gorget clasped, sword held.
Blue camp's sent heavy guard — no panic.

lines.zh: 这身甲要两个人帮着穿。
lines.en: This armor takes two to put on.
I'm here — the road is closed.
Shield planted like a second door.
Captain said hold, so I hold.

lines.zh: 靴子里塞了草，走起来轻些。
lines.en: Grass in my boots to soften the march.

lines.zh: 我看了一眼门洞，走进去。
lines.en: One look at the gateway, then in.
The weight of iron lands.

lines.zh: 盔甲被烧得发烫，烫得我直跳。
lines.en: The armor's heating up, I'm hopping.

lines.zh: 这身铁摔下来，压得我起不来。
lines.en: This iron landed with me — I can't get up.
Water pours in through the helm slit.
The blast slid me backward.
An arrow wedged in my gorget.

lines.zh: 符咒的光透过铁照进来。
lines.en: Spell-light shines through the iron.
Three days unfed — the armor sways.
Lightning ran down the whole plate.
The armor drags me into the dark.
